proposals.title: Give Each Share an Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan giving all outstanding stock one vote per share, phasing out Class B disproportionate voting rights within seven years.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairperson
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Directors to be Elected by Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending articles or bylaws so directors are elected by majority of votes cast, with plurality retained for contested elections.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Political Advertising
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the controversy surrounding political advertising and posts on Facebook, including implications of policies exempting politicians' content from platform rules.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors recommends that our stockholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Human/Civil Rights Expert on Board
proposals.topic_summary: Requests nomination of at least one independent director candidate with a high level of human and/or civil rights expertise.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors does not believe that setting aside a board seat for any pre-determined profile is a good corporate governance practice

proposals.title: Report on Civil and Human Rights Risks
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on board-level oversight of civil and human rights risks, including board expertise and responsibilities.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and not beneficial to our stockholders

proposals.title: Child Sexual Exploitation Online
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing risk of increased child sexual exploitation as Facebook develops end-to-end encryption and other privacy tools.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and not beneficial to our stockholders

proposals.title: Median Gender/Racial Pay Gap
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender/racial pay gap and related policy, reputational, and talent risks.
